verdict.rationale: Lovable ships built-in Basic and Deep security scanners specifically for reviewing generated apps for vulnerabilities, with enterprise tiers adding scheduled Deep scans and audit logs, directly matching the pre-launch security review story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the scanners catch real vulnerabilities, and community commentary (disclaimer requiring users to take responsibility for security, reports of abandoned apps with exposed data) raises doubt about how effective the review is in practice.
